evidence: src/claims/api/ClaimController.ts: FileClaimBody is a transport request DTO, which is a presentation concern.
ClaimController.file maps body fields to this.fileClaim.file(...), turning incidentOn into new Date(...). This is input adaptation only, and the result is returned as { claimId }.
ClaimController.settle passes the call to this.settleClaim.settle(claimId) and wraps the result as { paidCents }. It does not calculate the payout itself.
There is no persistence, no business rule and no infrastructure logic anywhere in the file.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: ClaimController is a thin presentation adapter. It defines a request body shape (FileClaimBody) and maps transport input to application use-case calls: it parses incidentOn into a Date and wraps the results in response DTOs. It contains no business rules, no persistence and no domain logic. Settlement calculation and claim validation are delegated to the application services FileClaim and SettleClaim. Every responsibility it carries belongs to the presentation layer kind.
